Container.Name: uhppote-desk
Container.Overview: Web application to manage UHPPOTE UT0311-L0x access controllers (1/2/4-door Wiegand boards), replacing the Windows "Access Control" software (N3000).[br][br] Controller discovery and configuration, people, cards and permissions with automatic sync, time profiles and scheduled tasks, live monitor with photos, event history, attendance reports, anomaly detection.[br] Home Assistant integration over MQTT (auto discovery), webhooks, Telegram/email/ntfy/Gotify notifications, automation rules and a mobile app (PWA) with fingerprint/Face ID.[br][br] Interface in English, Italian, Spanish, French and German. Requires "host" networking to discover the controllers and receive their UDP events.
Container.Requires: Network type "host" (already set): the controllers are discovered with UDP broadcast and send their events over UDP. Set "Event destination" to this server's IP and port 60001 (e.g. 192.168.1.10:60001) and "Discovery broadcast" to the broadcast address of the controllers' subnet (e.g. 192.168.1.255:60000).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, backups, test reports

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that will own the data folder (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that will own the data folder (Unraid: 100 = users)

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface (host networking: change it if already used by another container)

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password of the admin user, applied at every start. If empty, a password is generated on the first start (see the log) and must be changed at first login

Config.Name: Local IP facing the controllers
Config.Description: Server IP on the controllers' network (0.0.0.0 = all interfaces)

Config.Name: Discovery broadcast
Config.Description: Broadcast address used to discover controllers; the broadcast of the controllers' subnet is recommended, e.g. 192.168.1.255:60000

Config.Name: Event listen address
Config.Description: UDP address:port on which events are received

Config.Name: Event destination
Config.Description: IP:port of this server as reached by the controllers, e.g. 192.168.1.10:60001 (without it events arrive only through periodic polling)

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: true if published behind an HTTPS reverse proxy

Config.Name: Packet debug
Config.Description: Log every packet in hexadecimal

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Public HTTPS address behind a reverse proxy, e.g. https://doors.example.com (mobile app: fingerprint/Face ID, push). See docs/MOBILE.md

Config.Name: MQTT broker
Config.Description: Home Assistant integration: MQTT broker URL, e.g. mqtt://192.168.1.10:1883 (empty = disabled). See docs/HOME-ASSISTANT.md

Config.Name: MQTT username
Config.Description: MQTT broker user

Config.Name: MQTT password
Config.Description: MQTT broker password

Config.Name: MQTT door control
Config.Description: false = Home Assistant can see the doors but not open them

Config.Name: MQTT language
Config.Description: Language of the Home Assistant entity names and event texts: en, it, es, fr, de

Config.Name: MQTT base topic
Config.Description: Prefix of the published topics

Config.Name: MQTT discovery prefix
Config.Description: Home Assistant discovery prefix

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the time set on the controllers and for reports

Config.Name: Controller reply timeout
Config.Description: Maximum wait for a controller reply, in milliseconds

Config.Name: Retries
Config.Description: Additional attempts after a timeout (only for operations that can be repeated safely; door opening is never repeated)

Config.Name: Status check interval
Config.Description: Seconds between controller status checks (online/offline, doors)

Config.Name: Event download interval
Config.Description: Seconds between event downloads from the controllers, a safety net for events not received over UDP

Config.Name: Clock correction threshold
Config.Description: Difference in seconds beyond which the controller clock is corrected automatically (0 = never)

Config.Name: Initial event import
Config.Description: Number of events already stored on a controller to import the first time it is connected

Config.Name: Session duration
Config.Description: Operator session duration, in hours

Config.Name: Backup hour
Config.Description: Hour of the daily database backup into /data/backups (-1 = disabled)

Config.Name: Backups kept
Config.Description: Number of daily backups to keep

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warn or error
